title: Netanyahu Posts A.I. Video Pairing Mamdani With Iranian Ruler
summary_full: The video shows fictitious scenes of Mayor Zohran Mamdani on the phone, celebrating with Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei and others, at the prospect of Mr. Netanyahu losing re-election.
